items.item_text: Manage Seaver House operations, including welcoming visitors, answering and routing calls, coordinating office workflow, ordering supplies, maintaining filing systems, and supporting building-related communications and activities.

Serve as a primary point of contact for alumni, families, volunteers, students, campus partners, and visitors, providing responsive, professional, and solutions-oriented support while ensuring inquiries are addressed appropriately and in a timely manner.

Coordinate assigned administrative and operational processes in accordance with established departmental procedures, identifying opportunities for improvement and recommending enhancements to the Director or appropriate team members.
Serve as a key administrative resource for governance records, board materials, and volunteer leadership documentation.
Serve as a primary administrative contact for the Alumni Association Board and assigned committees, supporting communication, scheduling, logistics, documentation, and follow-up.
Maintain departmental calendars, schedules, files, and administrative records in support of team operations and program planning.
Coordinate mailings, acknowledgments, thank-you correspondence, constituent outreach, and other administrative communications through phone, email, and mail channels.
Collaborate with colleagues across Advancement and the College to support administrative processes, information sharing, volunteer engagement efforts, and coordinated constituent experiences.
Independently managing assigned operational processes.
Serve as departmental subject matter expert for governance records and board administration.
Identify operational improvements and implementing approved solutions.
Recommend enhancements to administrative workflows and constituent service processes.

Manage administrative and operational support for the Pomona College Alumni Association Board (PCAAB), Past Presidents Council (PPC), Leadership Development Committee (LDC), and other assigned volunteer leadership groups.
Serve as a primary staff liaison for the Alumni Association Board and assigned committees, supporting effective communication, coordination, and execution of volunteer leadership priorities.

Coordinate board and committee meeting logistics, including scheduling, registration, agenda development, materials preparation, meeting records, minutes, action item tracking, and follow-up communications.

Support volunteer governance processes, including member onboarding, orientation, leadership transitions, annual planning activities, committee administration, and maintenance of governance documentation.
Maintain board records, rosters, calendars, committee assignments, historical files, and related governance materials to ensure organizational continuity and institutional knowledge.

Partner with board officers, volunteer leaders, and College stakeholders to facilitate communication, establish clear expectations, and support the timely completion of board initiatives and priorities.
Support planning and implementation of board meetings, retreats, campus visits, volunteer recognition efforts, and other activities that strengthen volunteer engagement and leadership effectiveness.
Assist in tracking volunteer leadership participation, engagement activities, and governance-related records in support of stewardship, reporting, and ongoing volunteer development efforts.
Manage event registration processes for Alumni and Family Engagement programs, including registration setup, attendee tracking, reporting, and coordination with team members and campus partners.
Create, generate, and distribute Salesforce reports, constituent lists, and other engagement-related reports for Alumni and Family Engagement staff in partnership with Advancement Services.
Update constituent records as needed and support data integrity and information management practices in partnership with Advancement Services.
Manage alumni listservs and related communication distribution tools, including maintaining lists, updating records, coordinating communications, and supporting departmental outreach efforts.
Manage the Alumni and Family Engagement Facebook page and Sagehen Connect administrative approvals, monitor inquiries, and coordinate responses with appropriate staff members.

Manage department expense processes, including invoices, bills, credit card reconciliations, journal transfers, reimbursements, purchase orders, and supporting documentation while maintaining accurate financial records.
Assist with budget tracking, expense reconciliation, and financial documentation in support of departmental operations and engagement activities.
Coordinate administrative processes and information sharing with Advancement Services, Advancement Communications, Office of College Events, and other College partners as needed.
Support special projects, operational improvement initiatives, and other duties as assigned or requested.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of departmental procedures, documentation, and administrative workflows that promote efficiency, consistency, and service excellence.
Support Alumni and Family Engagement programs and events as needed, including occasional evening and weekend activities.
